capabilities: Enforce Reading view on notes matching include and exclude path rules
Lock and unlock notes or folders from the File Explorer context menu
Test which rule protects a path with the Path tester and Explain dialog
Toggle read-only mode and re-apply rules from the Command Palette
Show lock indicators beside protected notes in the File Explorer
disambiguation: Not a security or access-control tool; it only prevents accidental edits inside Obsidian and does not change filesystem permissions.
extras: 0BSD license; no network requests. New system-path imports require desktop Obsidian, though saved vault-relative paths then work on mobile. Full documentation is hosted externally.
motivation: The author wants to keep reference notes, documentation, dashboards, and archives in Reading view without accidentally opening the editor.
problem: Obsidian opens notes in the editor by default, so reference notes, documentation, dashboards, and archives can be modified by accident.

relations.evidence: Install Obsidian42 - BRAT from Community Plugins.

summary: Rule-based plugin that keeps selected Markdown notes in Reading view and prevents accidental edits using include and exclude path rules.
